title: Event Schema
description: A meaningful transition (Vol 1 §15: creation, delegation, approval, revocation, recovery, lifecycle change). Events preserve history; without them systems lose causality, accountability, and explanation - so event_type (what), timestamp (when), actor (who), and subject (on what) are required. The ontology calls for events even though the store is currently file-state (cf. KF-15). Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4.

event_type.description: the kind of transition, e.g. approval, revocation, recovery.

actor.description: object-ref id of who/what caused it (accountability).
